featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Ms Navu

We are sorry that you continue to feel disappointed about your experience with us.

A child being unwell is always concerning, and the daycare is always expected to be caring and supporting. While we do have a follow-up protocol in place for extended absences, we sincerely regret our team's oversight. Our Centre Head personally apologised for this at the time as they rightly should have. It was a miss on our part and not reflective of the care standards we strive to maintain at Eager Beaver.

However, having understood the point of contention, we would also like to clarify that your concern regarding fee adjustment relates to our existing daycare fee policies. We understand that your arrangement with the daycare was reimbursed by your company SBI Cards at that time until March. You exited the company and moved to retail plan. Since the child had attended daycare for only a few days in March(paid by SBI Cards), you were requesting a waiver of the daycare fee in May, which does not align with our daycare policies. While we understand that policies may not always feel satisfactory in difficult situations, it would be misleading to conclude from this that the school is “only about money.”

Anyone who truly knows our work would know that the relationships, care, and trust we build with children and families remain at the heart of what we do. We remain committed to learning from lapses while also upholding policies fairly and consistently across the community.

Warm Regards 
Team EB
